alternatives.reason_rejected: violates 'commit on the same branch' and leaves the commit unreachable from any ref if the worktree is cleaned up

context: Applied the review of fix/working-set-render (1258c30a): every free-text field now goes through one oneLine() normaliser, hook bookkeeping observations are excluded from the working set, result.error is never rendered, URL userinfo is stripped, 40-hex result shas shortened. 9 new tests, all red on 1258c30a.
rationale: The orchestrator required the commit on the same branch and `git branch -f` refuses a branch checked out elsewhere. Consequence: the -1 worktree's HEAD now points at the new commit while its files stay at 1258c30a, so `git status` there shows this commit's changes as reverse modifications until it is reset or pruned.
summary: Chose `git checkout --ignore-other-worktrees fix/working-set-render` to commit on the branch the orchestrator named while sibling worktree wf_e59d869d-75f-1 still had it checked out
